scope: Eval's runner gains --max-budget, so a routing trial can give each session a dollar limit (cr-r2pa.2.15).
method: Owner-directed change to Eval's runner: add optional --max-budget pass-through; verify supplied and omitted flags with a token-free stub. No upstream records were reclassified; real budget enforcement remains unverified.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/eval.md
why: A routing trial needs a dollar limit per session, which the runner could not set, so run.sh takes an optional --max-budget, passed to the session as --max-budget-usd only when given, in the form of --effort. A stub proved the flag is present when given and absent when not. A stub cannot prove the CLI ends a session on it, so that stays open until a real run.
